BookManagement.__init__:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Initialize the instance by setting the inventory attribute to a new empty dictionary." __init__]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self </REF>: object "The instance whose inventory attribute is initialized."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Assign a new empty dictionary to self.inventory, replacing any existing value and establishing an empty initial inventory state. RESULT self.inventory]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
BookManagement.add_book:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Adds a book title to the inventory by increasing its existing quantity or creating a new entry with the provided quantity." add_book]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> title </REF>: any "The book title used as the inventory key."
        <REF> quantity </REF>: any "The quantity to add for the title, defaulting to 1."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Check whether title already exists as a key in self.inventory. RESULT title_exists_in_inventory]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: If title_exists_in_inventory is true.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Update self.inventory[title] by adding quantity to the current stored value. RESULT self.inventory[title]]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: If title_exists_in_inventory is false.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Create self.inventory[title] and assign it the value quantity. RESULT self.inventory[title]]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
BookManagement.remove_book:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Remove the requested quantity of a book from inventory, failing when the title is missing or stock is insufficient and deleting the title entry if its remaining count becomes exactly zero." remove_book]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> title </REF>: string "The inventory key for the book to remove."
        <REF> quantity </REF>: number "The amount of stock to subtract from the book's current inventory count."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Check whether title is not present in self.inventory or, only if title is present, whether self.inventory[title] is strictly less than quantity. RESULT inventory_validation]
            [COMMAND Subtract quantity from self.inventory[title]. RESULT updated_inventory_count]
            [COMMAND If the updated self.inventory[title] is exactly 0, delete the title entry from self.inventory. RESULT inventory_cleanup]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [EXCEPTION_FLOW: title is not in self.inventory, or title exists but self.inventory[title] is strictly less than quantity.]
        [LOG "The method executes raise False on this failure path; in Python this is an invalid raise target and results in a TypeError instead of a domain-specific exception."]
        [THROW TypeError "Raised because the code explicitly executes raise False when the title is missing or available stock is less than the requested quantity."]
    [END_EXCEPTION_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
BookManagement.view_inventory:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Return the current inventory stored on the instance without modification." view_inventory]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self </REF>: object "The instance that holds the inventory attribute."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> inventory </REF>: any "The inventory attribute value from the instance."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return the inventory attribute from the current instance. RESULT inventory]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
BookManagement.view_book_quantity:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Returns the stored quantity for a given title, or 0 when the title is not present in the inventory." view_book_quantity]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self </REF>: object "The owning object containing the inventory mapping."
        <REF> title </REF>: any "The book title to look up in the inventory."
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: int "The quantity for the title, or 0 if the title is missing."
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Check whether the title exists in the inventory mapping. RESULT is_present]
            [COMMAND If the title is not present, return 0 immediately. RESULT 0]
            [COMMAND If the title is present, return the stored quantity for that title from the inventory. RESULT quantity]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: The title is not found in self.inventory.]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Return 0 as the missing-title default value. RESULT 0]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
